comment: radii larger than the box: all radii of a box are scaled by the smallest ratio of a side to the sum of its two radii (CSS Backgrounds 3, 5.5). Tolerance: the anti-aliased edge of a curve where it is nearly tangent to a pixel row or column: the engine fades it linearly over 1.1 px (feathering over 4x multisampling), Skia uses the covered area; such pixels differ by up to about 30 levels (scattered single pixels, no shape difference).
